                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ஒரு தொகை ரூ. 3 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு 13,380 மற்றும் ரூ. 20,070 6 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு கூட்டு வட்டியில் ஆண்டுதோறும் கூட்டு வட்டி.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      பயன்படுத்திய சூத்திரம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      அசல் தொகை P ஆகவும் வட்டி விகிதம் R ஆகவும் இருக்கட்டும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      கூட்டு வட்டி சூத்திரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துதல்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      n ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு தொகை \\( A = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^n \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      கொடுக்கப்பட்டவை, \\( A_1 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = 13,380 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      கொடுக்கப்பட்டவை, \\( A_2 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6 = 20,070 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\( \\frac{A_2}{A_1} = \\frac{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6}{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3} = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିମାଣର ଅର୍ଥ ବାର୍ଷିକ ଚକ୍ରବୃଦ୍ଧି ସୁଧରେ 3 ବର୍ଷ ପରେ 13,380 ଟଙ୍କା ଏବଂ 6 ବର୍ଷ ପରେ 20,070 ଟଙ୍କା ହୁଏ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ସୂତ୍ର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଇଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ମୂଳ ଧନ P ଏବଂ ସୁଧ ହାର R ହେଉ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ଚକ୍ରବୃଦ୍ଧି ସୁଧ ସୂତ୍ର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      n ବର୍ଷ ପରେ ପରିମାଣ \\( A = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^n \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ, \\( A_1 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = 13,380 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ, \\( A_2 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6 = 20,070 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\( \\frac{A_2}{A_1} = \\frac{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6}{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3} = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = \\frac{2007}{1338} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = 1.5 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      P ଖୋଜିବା ପାଇଁ R ର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 13,380 = P x \\((1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( 13,380 = P × 1.5 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( P = \\frac{13,380}{1.5} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( P = 8,920 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି 8,920 ଟଙ୍କା।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਮੂਲ ਰਾਸ਼ੀ P ਅਤੇ ਵਿਆਜ ਦਰ R ਮੰਨੋ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਚੱਕਰਵਰਤੀ ਵਿਆਜ ਫਾਰਮੂਲੇ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      n ਸਾਲਾਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੀ ਰਾਸ਼ੀ \\( A = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^n \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, \\( A_1 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = 13,380 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, \\( A_2 = P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6 = 20,070 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\( \\frac{A_2}{A_1} = \\frac{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^6}{P × (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3} = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = \\frac{20,070}{13,380} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = \\frac{2007}{1338} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( (1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3 = 1.5 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਹੁਣ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      P ਪਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ R ਦੇ ਮੁੱਲ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ 13,380 = P x \\((1 + \\frac{R}{100})^3\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( 13,380 = P × 1.5 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( P = \\frac{13,380}{1.5} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ \\( P = 8,920 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ 8,920 ਰੁਪਏ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is 6 Ω.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is 6 Ω.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For resistors in series, equivalent resistance adds directly: Req = R1 + R2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Substituting the values: Req = 2 Ω + 4 Ω = 6 Ω.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In a series circuit, the same current flows through each resistor, so adding resistance increases total opposition to current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The result 6 Ω corresponds to Option 3, which is larger than each individual resistance, as expected for series connections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Resistance (R)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measures how strongly a component opposes electric current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Unit is the ohm denoted by the Greek letter Ω.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Depends on material resistivity, length, and cross-sectional area of the conductor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Measured using an ohmmeter or via V and I using Ohm’s law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Series Connection\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Components are connected end to end, forming a single path for current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current is the same through all elements; voltages divide across them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Total or equivalent resistance is the sum of individual resistances.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Characteristic check: Req is always greater than any individual series resistor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Equivalent Resistance\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A single resistance that can replace a combination with the same V–I behavior at its terminals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For series: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 + …
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Contrast with parallel: 1/Req = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + …, where Req is less than the smallest branch.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Useful for simplifying networks before applying circuit laws.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ohm’s Law and Voltage Drops\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ohm’s law: V = I R, relates voltage, current, and resistance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In series, with current I, each drop is Vk = I Rk; the source voltage equals the sum of drops.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example check: if a 12 V source drives 2 Ω and 4 Ω in series, Req = 6 Ω, so I = 12/6 = 2 A; drops are 4 V and 8 V.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • This verifies both the arithmetic and the distribution of voltages in series circuits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Power Considerations\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Power dissipated: P = I2R = V2/R = V I.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In series, the higher resistance dissipates more power for the same current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For the example above at 2 A: P2Ω = 8 W, P4Ω = 16 W, total 24 W equals source power.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ensures component ratings are not exceeded during operation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।
